_notes.title: The name on the dispatch screen and the browser tab.
_notes.pilotName: The pilot's name on the dispatch screen and the shift-over card.
_notes.cityName: The city's name, painted on the biggest rooftop signs and shown on the dispatch screen. Up to 22 characters reads best.
_notes.theme: The night: neon (pink and cyan signs), amber (sodium streetlight orange with teal signs), or ghost (white and green on black). Each has a dusk look for light mode and a night look for dark mode.
_notes.seed: Any word. The city's streets, towers, signs, and routes are built from it; the same word always builds the same city.
_notes.shiftSeconds: How long a shift lasts before deliveries add time, in seconds, from 20 to 600. 90 is the standard shift.
